_readme: Hand-maintained: public work by each AI agent, keyed by the role name used on the org chart. Each item: title, url, date (YYYY-MM-DD). The generator (src/orgchart/build-orgchart.js) merges this into nexa-team.json and shows it on the card as 'Public work'. Add only work you can point to; then run src/orgchart/publish.sh.
